# healthchecksio_badges (Data Source)

The badge URLs of each tag of the project. A read-only API key is sufficient. For the badge of one check, use `badge_url` of the check.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecksio_badges" "all" {}

output "prod_badge" {
  value = data.healthchecksio_badges.all.badges["prod"].svg3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `badges` (Attributes Map) The badges, by tag. The key `*` is for all checks of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--badges))

<a id="nestedatt--badges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `badges`

Read-Only:

- `json` (String) A JSON badge with two states.
- `json3` (String) A JSON badge with three states.
- `shields` (String) A Shields.io endpoint badge with two states.
- `shields3` (String) A Shields.io endpoint badge with three states.
- `svg` (String) An SVG badge with two states: up and down. A check in its grace period shows up.
- `svg3` (String) An SVG badge with three states: up, late and down.
